puzzle.body: When VerboseProcess is closed, we should also shut down the monitor threads and prevent them trying to obtain the output from the process. It should be done before destroy() is called. See the following for more details: https://github.com/jcabi/jcabi-log/issues/38 http://www.java2s.com/Code/Java/Threads/Thesafewaytostopathread.htm

Create an integration test for testing if MulticolorLayout will disable text coloring when an application is run with `-Dcom.jcabi.log.coloring=false`. ... Intergration testing is required because this can't be done in a unit test: ... - We can't just pass a parameter to `MulticolorLayout` that determines if the layout should color its output, because Log4J requires EnhancedPatternLayout to have a 0-arguments constructor. - We can't disable coloring with something like `MulticolorLayout#setColoring(boolean)`, too, (that would be unit-testable) because Log4J won't know how to call that. - `System.getProperty(String)` is not mockable for obvious reasons.
